//: Monorepo root — apps/* and packages/* are pnpm workspaces. Local: `pnpm dev:all` / `pnpm stop` / `pnpm verify`. Hostinger (same repo, three Web App slots): use `build:api`+`start:api`, `build:web` (static output `apps/web/dist`), `build:worker`+`start:worker` — keep Hostinger root directory at repo root. Docs: docs/guidelines/README.md, docs/runbooks/deploy.md.
name: saas-starter-pack

scripts.verify: pnpm typecheck && pnpm build:packages && pnpm test
scripts.lint:tests: cross-env ESLINT_USE_FLAT_CONFIG=false eslint apps/api/test apps/worker/test packages/crypto/test packages/db/test packages/logger/test packages/shared/test e2e --ext .ts
scripts.lint:src: cross-env ESLINT_USE_FLAT_CONFIG=false eslint apps/api/src apps/web/src apps/worker/src apps/mobile packages/shared/src packages/db/src packages/crypto/src packages/logger/src --ext .ts,.tsx
